subject: general
question: According to Census 2011, which among the following has the minimum population density?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh** has the **minimum population density **according to **Census 2011.**
 
• The population density of Arunachal Pradesh is **17 persons per square kilometer.**
 
• **Chandigarh**, on the other hand, has the** highest population density** among given options with **9252 persons per square kilometer.**
 
• **Andhra Pradesh** has a population density of **308 persons per square kilometer **and **Sikkim **has a population density of **86 persons per square kilometer.**
 
• **Population density** is the number of **people living** in a particular **area per unit of land.**
 
• It is an important indicator of the **level of development and resource use **in a region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chandigarh** is a **Union Territory **and a** city **that serves as the **capital **of the states of **Punjab and Haryana.**

 
 
• It is one of the** most planned cities** in India and has a high standard of living.
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh** is a state in southern India with a population of over **49 million.**
 
 
• It is the **seventh-largest state** in India by area and the** tenth-largest by population.**
 
 
 
• **Sikkim** is a state in **northeastern India **and is the least populous state in the country.
 
 
• It is known for its natural beauty and is a **popular tourist destination.**
